payload.reason: The evidence provides specific graph-based features that are considered in the analysis.

claims.text: The graph-based features include Coreness, Strength, Closeness, and Reciprocity.
Coreness and Strength help detect changes in the direct neighborhood of the targeted author.
Closeness measures average node centrality in terms of distance across the graph.
Reciprocity reflects the general reciprocity of exchanges between users.
